title: Enterprise accounts with a failed invoice in 2025
prompt: How many accounts in the enterprise segment have at least one failed invoice in 2025?
population: Enterprise-segment accounts, joined to their 2025 invoices.
metricDefinition: count of distinct enterprise-segment accounts with ≥1 failed invoice in 2025.
transformationPlan: filter invoices to 2025 with status = failed
join to accounts, filter to segment = enterprise
referenceSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT a.account_id) FROM accounts a JOIN invoices i ON i.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.segment = 'enterprise' AND i.status = 'failed' AND i.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND i.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
